title: Professional and friendly. We will repeat
text:
Well located center, with several parking options nearby and blue area also nearby.
Cozy place, very clean and the room we used on this occasion was very spacious. 
Very attentive staff, taking care of all the details. When we arrived they had everything ready and the room at pleasant temperature (warm) for comfort during the session.
We had an 80 minute couple massage session. We were both delighted with the massage, it was complete from head to toe. My husband had already gone before, for me it was the first time and surely repeat later.

title: Truly lives up to its name!
text:
While hiking through Spain, my friend and I were in serious need of some recovery time—and we’re so glad we found Masvital in Granada. We booked a couples massage online, and it turned out to be one of the highlights of our trip.

The experience was absolutely wonderful from start to finish. The space was calm, clean, and welcoming, and the masseuses were incredibly professional, intuitive, and kind. What really stood out was how they tailored the massage to each of our needs. My friend requested a very deep tissue massage and was amazed at how effectively the therapist worked through tension

title: Incredible experience with unbeatable treatment
